title: C-EQ-ALINEA – Distributed, Coordinated, and Equitable Ramp Metering Strategy for Sustainable Freeway Operations
reasoning: The paper uses ethical and philosophical frameworks of justice (such as Rawlsian and Aristotelian perspectives) to define fairness metrics for traffic engineering and ramp metering. However, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a subject of study, but rather applies these concepts as performance indicators for a transportation control system.
